title: Relevance Judgment Convergence Degree – A Measure of Inconsistency among Assessors for Information Retrieval
reasoning: The paper introduces a new metric (Relevance Judgment Convergence Degree - RJCD) to measure the quality of queries for Information Retrieval (IR) system evaluation datasets. It discusses issues related to potentially biased human relevance judgments and aims to improve the quality of ground truth data used for evaluating IR systems. There is no component of evaluating or benchmarking religion, morals, or ethics.
